app.title: Teardown Mod Maker
app.tagline: Snap blocks together to make your own Teardown mod
app.help_hint: Hold T to see what things mean
app.help_title: Help mode: let go of T to close
app.code_note: The blocks write this code for you. Teardown reads it to run your mod.
app.confirm_new: Start a new mod? Your blocks will be cleared.
app.open_failed: That file couldn't be opened. Pick a file you saved from this app.
app.author: Your name
app.vox_hint: Made in MagicaVoxel. Leave empty to use a simple stick.
app.install_steps: 1. Unzip the file. 2. Put the folder in Documents\Teardown\mods. 3. In Teardown, open Mod Manager, turn your mod on, then play Sandbox.

errors.empty_mod: Your mod has no blocks yet. Drag an event block in first.
errors.too_big: Your mod is too big. Try removing some blocks.
errors.vox_too_big: That .vox file is too big (2 MB max).
errors.not_vox: That doesn't look like a .vox file.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the app. Is it still running?

blocks.unused_comment: Blocks not inside an event block don't run.

mod.name: Mod
mod.desc: A change or add-on for a game. Your mod adds new things to Teardown.

lua.name: Lua
lua.desc: The programming language Teardown mods are written in. The blocks write it for you.

vox.name: .vox file
vox.desc: A 3D model made of little cubes (voxels). You can make one in MagicaVoxel.

frame.name: Frame
frame.desc: The game redraws the screen about 60 times a second. Each redraw is one frame.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Something that happens, like pressing a key. Blocks inside an event run when it happens.

events.name: Events
events.desc: Blocks that start things. Every other block must go inside one of these.

actions.name: Actions
actions.desc: Blocks that make something happen in the game, like an explosion.

player.name: Player
player.desc: Blocks that change you: your health, where you are and how you move.

places.name: Places
places.desc: Blocks that pick a spot in the world, like where you're looking.

logic.name: If / Then
logic.desc: Only do something when a question is true, like 'is my health below 50?'.

loops.name: Repeat
loops.desc: Do the same blocks several times in a row.

math.name: Numbers
math.desc: Numbers and maths, like adding or picking a random number.

text.name: Text
text.desc: Words and letters, like a message to show on screen.

variables.name: Variable
variables.desc: A named box that remembers a value, like a score.

when_start.name: When the game starts
when_start.desc: Runs once, when the level loads.

every_frame.name: Every frame
every_frame.desc: Runs all the time, about 60 times a second. Careful: explosions here happen non-stop!

when_key.name: When key is pressed
when_key.desc: Runs once each time you press that key in the game.

tool.name: Tool
tool.desc: Something you hold and use in Teardown, like the sledgehammer. Click to use it in game.

explode.name: Explosion
explode.desc: Blows things up. Size goes from 0.5 (small pop) to 4 (huge boom).

hole.name: Make a hole
hole.desc: Removes blocks in a ball shape without a bang.

fire.name: Fire
fire.desc: Sets the spot on fire. Wood burns, metal doesn't.

shoot.name: Shoot
shoot.desc: Fires a bullet or rocket from where you're looking.

message.name: Show message
message.desc: Writes text on the screen. Great for testing if your blocks run.

set_health.name: Health
set_health.desc: How alive you are. 100% is full, 0% means game over.

health.name: My health
health.desc: Your health right now, from 0 to 100.

launch.name: Launch
launch.desc: Throws you up into the air. Bigger power means higher.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Moves you to a place instantly.

slowmo.name: Slow motion
slowmo.desc: Makes the whole game slow down for a few seconds.

look_point.name: Where I'm looking
look_point.desc: The spot in the middle of your screen, up to 100 metres away.

my_pos.name: My position
my_pos.desc: The spot where you are standing.

in_front.name: In front of me
in_front.desc: A spot some metres ahead of you, in the air if nothing is there.

if.name: If
if.desc: Checks a question. The blocks inside only run if the answer is true.

compare.name: Compare
compare.desc: Asks if two numbers are equal, bigger or smaller.

and_or.name: And / Or
and_or.desc: Joins two questions. 'And' needs both true, 'or' needs one.

true_false.name: True / False
true_false.desc: Yes or no. The answer to a question.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.desc: Runs the blocks inside this many times.

arithmetic.name: Maths
arithmetic.desc: Adds, takes away, multiplies or divides two numbers.

random.name: Random number
random.desc: Picks a surprise number between two numbers.

variable_set.name: Set variable
variable_set.desc: Puts a value in a variable so you can use it later.

variable_get.name: Variable
variable_get.desc: Gets the value stored in a variable.

new.name: New
new.desc: Clears the blocks so you can start a new mod.

open.name: Open
open.desc: Loads a mod you saved before.

save.name: Save
save.desc: Saves your blocks to a file so you can keep working later.

show_code.name: Show code
show_code.desc: Shows the Lua code your blocks make. This is what real modders write.

download.name: Download mod
download.desc: Makes a zip file you can put in Teardown's mods folder.

workspace.name: Workspace
workspace.desc: Drag blocks here and snap them together. Drag a block to the bin to delete it.
